policy: Frozen A/B protocol evaluation from the same untouched initial Case Files. No baseline scientific output or posthoc mechanism analysis is seeded. Three changes: factual capability-aware predictions, Critic-targeted revision acceptance, and explicit hypothesis/outcome discrimination in evidence planning. Only RESOLVED acceptance consumes successful revision budget; PARTIAL/UNRESOLVED may retry within two acceptance attempts per request, existing bounded model/stage attempts, 12 transitions and 80 provider calls. Tools, model, context and numeric scientific/operational budgets otherwise retain baseline limits. C/D remain paused. C1 is never bypassed to achieve the C2 metric. All outcomes and failures are retained; a combined two-case protocol evolution pilot does not identify the causal effect of each individual change. Technical continuation retains A calls 1–5 and failed-stage history. A remaining initial stage has at most two Explorer generation attempts and no further stage retry; these tighter caps also apply to later A stages. B has not started. Format/namespace fixes do not alter scientific acceptance.

acceptance_criterion.primary: At least one A/B case commits nonempty claim-level evidence audits after passing C1. A winning mechanism is not required.
secondary: capability IDs on all new evidence questions
Critic acceptance records for every submitted revision
Investigator predeclared comparison outcomes and advisory information updates
all evidence sources REAL and initial facts unchanged
acceptance_criterion.failure_policy: Stop at frozen limits. No budget escalation, C1 weakening, case substitution or selective omission.
